what: Live spectate + physics check against Maincloud database scary-5zsk8 after the owner (identity c2001826…) published branch samer/spectate-physics at 33b34c6.
schema: Public schema read after publish: tables expiry, physics_body, physics_tick, physics_world, session, spectator_vitals, vitals_sweep; views judge_trace, physics_feed, spectator_vitals_feed.
sensing: The check posts SIMULATED vitals; no camera or Presage involved.

results.check: first trace batch creates a resting 12-prop world visible to the spectator
SCARE impact wakes props and the server tick advances them
props settle back to sleep within 4 s, displaced by the pound
the world's tick freezes once every prop sleeps (verify the physics_tick row with owner SQL separately)
a resent event batch does not re-apply its impulse
no vitals row exists before the player opts in
opted-in vitals reach the spectator, labelled simulated, without a server clock
an accepted reading without a pulse is rejected
a wrong owner capability cannot write vitals
a later reading replaces the row (latest value only)
withdrawing consent deletes the row for the spectator
an abandoned heart-rate row is swept within 21 s
an owner knock moves exactly that prop
a spectator with the wrong capability receives no rows at all
removing the session removes trace and props from the spectator

ownerSqlAfterRun.command: spacetime sql -s maincloud scary-5zsk8 "SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM <table>" (read-only, as the database owner)

notChecked: A friend on another machine or network (needs a hosted web build via VITE_SPECTATE_ORIGIN); Electron with live Presage.

browser.player: http://127.0.0.1:5182 (npm run dev with VITE_SPACETIMEDB_HOST=wss://maincloud.spacetimedb.com, VITE_SPACETIMEDB_DB_NAME=scary-5zsk8), SIMULATED sensing, trace sharing on; J panel read 'SpacetimeDB live trace' and the button read 'Copy spectate link' (remote session ready).
browser.spectator: http://localhost:5182/#watch=… (separate origin, Maincloud only): 'Live · SpacetimeDB', SIMULATED 72 BPM, 0 vs baseline, Holding steady, Stage 1 of 4, creature 17-18 of 24, exposure 11-12%, 'PROPS · SPACETIMEDB PHYSICS'.
